card.name: The digit 1 starting a number
card.fires_on: The digit 1 when it begins a longer number, such as 12, 14, 10 or 1,625, mostly in dose tables, age ranges and day or week counts. It also fires on a lone 1 before year or mcg/kg.

modes.label: Age and day ranges
modes.description: The digit 1 opens the upper end of an age or day range, or stands alone before year.

modes.label: Table values and increments
modes.description: The digit 1 begins a number in a dosing table, a weight cutoff or a step size.

card.plain: It marks the digit 1 at the start of a number in dose tables and age ranges.
